name: @searchkernel/client
description: Browser-capable TypeScript client for Search Kernel

scripts.generate: npm run generate:flatbuffers && npm run generate:grpc-web
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.all.json && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json
scripts.example:e2e: npm run build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.example-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.build.json && node .example-dist/try_searchkernel_client_api_e2e.js
